in_scope_scenarios: Users try to retrieve photos when they only recall vague cues (e.g., subject, person, approximate date, or event) and cannot locate the image via the built‑in search. This includes attempts with keyword search, AI‑augmented search, facial‑name search, and manual scrolling after UI changes. [IDs: 4,7,8,12,18,25,29,30,33,39,45,52,62,101,112,118,122,137,148,151]
remembered_landscape: Across the data set users frequently remember high‑level cues such as the subject ("Dog in a hat" [29]), a person’s face or name ([25,30]), a rough date or time stamp ("6‑year‑old photos" [18]; "downloaded at 12:55 am on July 27" [45]), event context ("photo of an order" [12]), month boundaries ([142]), or that a screenshot was marked as a favorite ([33]).
forgotten_landscape: What is commonly missing are precise identifiers: exact file names, album titles, exact timestamps, folder locations, or the specific visual content of a remembered item. Examples include forgetting the screenshot’s exact content ([33]), losing album titles and dates ([151]), and lacking searchable location tags after UI changes ([148]).
search_behaviors: Users first issue keyword or AI queries (e.g., "Dog in a hat" [29]; AI search [7,8]), try name‑based facial searches ([25,30]), rely on date cues ([39,122]), or fall back to manual scrolling through years, months, or "Recently Added" sections ([18,62,112]). When search returns nothing they resort to exhaustive scrolling or downgrade the app version ([52]).
retrieval_failures: The dominant failure mode is **QUERY → RETRIEVAL FAILURE**, reported in the majority of cases (IDs 4,7,8,12,18,29,30,33,36,39,42,45,52,54,59,66,101,112,118,122,148,149,151,155). One instance of **RETRIEVAL → RECOGNITION FAILURE** occurs with mis‑tagged faces ([25]). Two cases of **SEARCH RECOVERY FAILURE** arise from UI lacking date separators, forcing manual navigation ([62,146]).
opportunities:
- **Enhanced semantic query translation** to bridge vague memory cues (e.g., "dog in a hat", approximate dates) to accurate results. [IDs: 29,39,122]
- **Robust AI relevance ranking** that surfaces likely matches even when exact keywords are missing. [IDs: 7,8]
- **Persistent contextual metadata** (album titles, location tags, download timestamps) that remain searchable after UI updates. [IDs: 151,148]
- **Improved facial‑name linking** with higher accuracy and user‑editable tags to reduce recognition failures. [ID: 25]
- **UI redesign with clear date/month separators or quick‑jump controls** to alleviate scrolling fatigue. [IDs: 18,122,146]
- **Dedicated screenshot/library shortcuts** (e.g., "Favorites", "Recent Screenshots") that are discoverable without multiple taps. [IDs: 33,62,137]
- **Backup visibility tools** that confirm where backed‑up photos reside and allow direct retrieval. [IDs: 36,54,59,149]
